# Bitlync

One API for ISVs. Write once. Connect to many MSPs.

Human docs: https://www.bitlync.com/#docs
Site: https://www.bitlync.com/

## Sandbox

- Public sandbox host: https://bitlync-sandbox-demo.onrender.com
- Demo key is on https://www.bitlync.com/#docs-quickstart
- Fixture data only. Not a customer tenant. Not production AWS.
- GET /tenants/sandbox-mainstreet/tickets returns 200 and sandbox: true.
- There is no public live-read URL for a real MSP.
- No production host printed here besides the sandbox.
- This page does not document a vendor daily cap.
- No public ops host on this page.
- There is no public MCP host.
- The ISV does not paste MSP creds. There is no shared-secret path that puts PSA keys in your app.

## Writes and refusals

- dry_run defaults true. A dry run does not create a ticket.
- We do not mint an agreement header. We do not mint a project header.
- We do not create a company in the PSA.
- We never write devices. We never auto-create an unmatched company.
- Not two-way tickets. We do not watch the MSP close or edit.
- Close defaults off unless the MSP turns it on.
- A parked write is 501, not a generic 500.
